items.title: The Usefulness of AI Agents
items.raw_excerpt: Agentic AI is having its moment (or its decade, as some have put it ). I have been researching LLM-powered agents for the last two years, but research (involving publicly funded projects and academic peer review) is slow, and cannot keep up with the breakneck speed of the development and deployment going on in the tech industry as a whole. Especially not when AI tools are used to assist in programming new tools and frameworks. Small-scale experiments are quickly made obsolete

title_i18n.zh: AI代理的有用性
title_i18n.es: La utilidad de los agentes de IA

I have been researching LLM-powered agents for the last two years, but research (involving publicly funded projects and academic peer review) is slow, and cannot keep up with the breakneck speed of the development and deployment going on in the tech industry as a whole. items.title: Bash4LLM+ – A lightweight, dependency-free Bash wrapper for LLM APIs
items.raw_excerpt: Bash4LLM is a single-file Bash wrapper for interacting with LLMs from the terminal. I created it because I wanted something simple that worked without installing Python, Node, or any other runtime. It uses only Bash, curl, and jq. You can send prompts, start a small chat, process files line by line, stream output, and save session metadata in JSON format. I tried to make it safe and predictable: no use of the system /tmp, no use of eval. Groq is supported by default, and other providers can be added with dedicated Bash scripts in the extras/providers/ folder. Example: echo "explains the command: ls -l" | ./bash4llm

items.title: Prose or Con, can you detect AI writing?
items.raw_excerpt: There was a recent thread about a tool that "proves" a human actually wrote something via an animated edit history ( https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48699969 ). I commented that I can recognize AI writing regardless of such tools, and received some pushback...so, I wanted to be sure I wasn't lying to myself, and made a little game that shows samples or writing in a variety of styles, and you pick whether it's human or AI. It's harder than I expected, especially with current frontier models, but I think AI prose is still detectable.

items.title: AI is creating America's next underclass
items.raw_excerpt: The article argues that AI is creating a new underclass in America by displacing middle- and low-income jobs, and calls for new social norms to address the resulting inequalities.

title_i18n.en: AI is creating America's next underclass
title_i18n.zh: 人工智能正在创造美国的下一个下层阶级
title_i18n.es: La IA está creando la próxima subclase de Estados Unidos

excerpt_i18n.en: The article argues that AI is creating a new underclass in America by displacing middle- and low-income jobs, and calls for new social norms to address the resulting inequalities.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 本文认为，人工智能技术正在加速美国社会的分层，可能导致大量中低收入岗位消失，形成一个被AI边缘化的“新底层阶级”。作者呼吁建立新的社会规范，以应对AI带来的经济和社会挑战。

items.title: Professor denounces mass AI fraud on an exam at Brown
items.raw_excerpt: A Brown University professor publicly denounced a mass AI fraud incident on an exam, where students used AI to cheat, severely threatening academic integrity. The case has sparked broad discussions on how universities should address AI misuse.

title_i18n.en: Professor denounces mass AI fraud on an exam at Brown
title_i18n.zh: 布朗大学教授谴责考试中出现大规模AI欺诈行为
title_i18n.es: Un profesor denuncia un fraude masivo de IA en un examen en Brown.

excerpt_i18n.en: A Brown University professor publicly denounced a mass AI fraud incident on an exam, where students used AI to cheat, severely threatening academic integrity. The case has sparked broad discussions on how universities should address AI misuse.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 布朗大学一位教授公开谴责一起大规模AI欺诈考试事件，指出学生在考试中利用人工智能作弊，严重威胁学术诚信。该事件引发对高校如何应对AI技术滥用的广泛讨论。
